purpose: READ-ONLY portfolio-facts snapshot. NOT a sizing/policy decision. risk_policy is always UNRATIFIED and position_size is always NOT_COMPUTABLE_POLICY_UNRATIFIED in every packet this contract governs.

alpaca.note: Transport only. AVAILABLE means the exact provider pair is present; it does not mean canonical instrument identity is resolved or investable.

manual.note: An optional complete provider pair may be retained for audit, but manual input can never claim AVAILABLE and no ticker-to-provider inference is permitted.

real_data_persistence.note: This repo is PUBLIC. No real NAV/cash/positions/P&L/account_id_hash is ever written to any file, committed or otherwise, by this contract's code path. A live capture builds and verifies a real snapshot entirely in memory and discards it; only an explicitly allowlisted, non-sensitive summary (see portfolio_risk/capture.py::PUBLIC_SAFE_CAPTURE_RESULT_KEYS) is ever returned or printed. Real persistence requires a future, separately-designed PRIVATE evidence store -- not in scope for this contract version.
